{{Top}} {{Citation}} {{TCWRetcon}} {{Character |type=Hutt Cartel |image=[[File:Jabba-SWI143.png]] |name=Jabba Desilijic Tiure |homeworld=[[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'' |birth=[[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' Nal Hutta |death=[[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]{{Film|VI}} |species=[[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Male]]''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' |pronouns=He/him |height=*3.9 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long *1.75 meters tall''[[Star Wars: Head-to-Head Tag Teams]]'' |mass=1,358 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color/Legends|Orange-yellow-red]] |skin=Green-tan/brown |cyber= |families=[[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] |parents=[[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]]''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]'' |partners= |siblings= |children=[[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] |affiliation=*[[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' **[[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]]{{TCW|Evil Plans}} **[[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire]] *[[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] {{C|briefly}}{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|If I told you half the things I've heard about this Jabba the Hutt, you'd probably short-circuit!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|}} '''Jabba Desilijic Tiure''', better known as '''Jabba the Hutt''' and often called "'''the Bloated One'''", though never to his face,''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' was one of the most notorious [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], who governed a large [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal empire]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] from his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|desert palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At the height of his power, Jabba was one of the most powerful crime lords in the galaxy, even having contact with [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], the head of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun Syndicate]]. Jabba had started as a small crime lord, but quickly spread his influence into a variety of illegal activities, including [[Glitterstim/Legends|spice]]-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]], gunrunning, [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], and sometimes outright [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. Known for his cruelty and carnal fancies, Jabba the Hutt was powerful enough to command respect and payment from the Galaxy's ruling government, so much so that during the Clone Wars the Republic went to great lengths to avoid Jabba's displeasure. He later placed a hefty death mark on [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], a former employee of his, after Solo lost a load of spice to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] patrol vessel. He would finally get his revenge on Solo when the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-encased [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] was delivered to him by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], one of the many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] Jabba was known to employ. However, this mission was Jabba's undoing, as a rescue mission and subsequent [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|battle]] with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his allies resulted in the Hutt's demise at the hands of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. ==Biography== ===Early life (600 BBY–22 BBY)=== ====Rise of the crime lord==== {{Quote|I see only a festering, mountainous pustule which fancies himself to be a high lord of merchants and criminals.|[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''}} Jabba, who was born on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], was the child of [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]]. He took formal control of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], when he killed the offspring of [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|Jiliac]], the former leader. The old Hutt died following a grueling fight to the death with [[Durga Besadii Tai]].''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' [[File:Jabba_Boonta_Eve.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jabba hosts the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]].]] At the incredibly young age of 80, the up-and-coming [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] established his criminal empire on the remote desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], located in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. In [[516 BBY]], he moved his criminal operations into an old [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|B'omarr Monastery]], safely nestling himself in the planet's comfortable obscurity.''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' Jabba started small, finding early work as a high-risk gunrunner, along with his lifelong friend [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]]. During [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] rise to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|power]], the Hutt was one of several gangsters who made his bid for dominance. His competitors included [[Sise Fromm]], the then-kingpin of organized crime in the galaxy and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], fledgling heir to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal empire. Though neither Xizor nor Jabba were by any means young, both had just been handed the reins of power established by their respective criminal families. While Fromm played war games, Xizor and Jabba sensed the winds of change and spent their resources garnering favor with those who seemed to be shifting into power. Due to the attractive nature of becoming a gangster during the galaxy's time of change, he attained minions. After his [[Sevan Domna|majordomo's]] death,''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] would become his new majordomo early on. He was always in attendance where Jabba was, be it [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]], the Palace, or other ventures. Bib would later be replaced by [[Naroon Cuthus]], only to take power again years later. Jabba kept an enormous, [[Jabba's champion|reptilian-humanoid creature]] as [[Jabba's champion|his champion]] gladiator in a spike-pit arena under [[Jabba's private box|his suite]] in the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Grand Arena]], where he used the beast to get rid of undesirable individuals in death matches for his own amusement. Upon learning that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] needed [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] in order to bet on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] podrace, Jabba lured Jinn to his arena, and offered him the money he needed if he could defeat his champion. Jinn was successful in killing the predator, and an impressed Jabba thanked the Jedi Master for "providing such worthy entertainment," rewarded him with 50 peggats and released him from the pit. [[File:JTHAOTD-FC.jpg|thumb|200px|The notorious crime lord Jabba the Hutt]] Jabba was known to bet on podraces. He often lost, due to the recommendations of his incompetent [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R5-X2/Legends|R5-X2]]."[[Podracing Tales]]" During such races he was, on occasion, the host, such as at the Boonta Eve Classic, which Xizor also attended. Jabba never had any interest in the sport—sometimes falling asleep during the race—other than the profits made from inside bettors and the joy that came from having others owe him [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], especially the junk dealer [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. When Jabba did win, he was rewarded with enslaved girls and credits. He made sure that he always got his money's worth "the easy way, or the hard way." ====Interfering with Jedi business==== {{Quote|I have no wish to offend the Jedi. This would benefit no one.|Jabba, deceiving [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]|}} [[File:JabbaKiAdiMundi-SWREP8.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and Jabba meet]] Ephant Mon and Jabba made an ill-fated plan to smuggle goods onto Cerea where they encountered Jedi Master [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], whose daughter and a friend of his had been enslaved by the Hutt. Mundi had to wait for a dangerous lightning storm before he had a chance to free his daughter and friend from the Hutt's slimy grasp, though he was successful in rescuing both [[Sylvn (Cerean)|Sylvn]] and her friend [[Twin (Cerean)|Twin]]. On his mission, Mundi found evidence that linked Jabba with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] arming in preparation for its [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]], but the Hutt escaped any serious retribution.''[[Star Wars: Prelude to Rebellion]]'' When Mundi later returned to Tatooine to seek safe passage across the desert dunes, Jabba thought he recognized the Jedi Master, and lied to him about being an honorable being. He sent Mundi out on a [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]], accompanied by a few of the Hutt's guards, who were to "keep him safe from harm"; however, Bib Fortuna, the Hutt's majordomo, noted that they had sent the Jedi towards a sandstorm. Mundi realized this early on during the ride, to which Jabba sarcastically replied: :''A pity I wasn't warned sooner. I hope nothing tragic happens during that storm. It would be hard to find a body under all those sand drifts.'' Fortuna and the Hutt laughed as the skiff rode further towards the sandstorm ahead, though Mundi survived and continued to oppose Jabba in his efforts to incite the locals against the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]]. ====Rivalry with Gardulla==== {{Quote|I look forward to hearing of Gardulla's death.|Jabba|}} [[File:GardullavsJabba.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla]] and Jabba have their bets on [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|the race]].]] Jabba had a fierce rivalry with [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] that lasted for decades. Gardulla's attempt to establish a new podrace course on Tatooine brought the Besadii into conflict with the Desilijic, and the two clans were vying for control of the planet as early as [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. The gang war would continue for nearly three decades until [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], when Jabba, with Bib Fortuna, Ephant Mon and [[Diva Shaliqua/Legends|Diva Shaliqua]], had a clandestine meeting with [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask II]] on [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]]. Damask was secretly the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Plagueis, but Jabba demanded that he end his and elements of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] support for Gardulla. In exchange, Jabba offered information on the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] syndicate that had been targeting the leadership of some of the shipping cartels Plagueis backed: [[Komari Vosa]], believed dead after a disastrous [[Battle of Baltizaar|mission]] to [[Baltizaar/Legends|Baltizaar]] and the former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], was alive and had come to lead the cult. Jabba further revealed that Vosa had entered into a plan with Gardulla, a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] named [[Sebolto]], and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] to distribute contaminated [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] to draw new members to the cult.[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] Plagueis saw the information as a chance to draw Master Dooku closer to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], and also to push his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] Darth Sidious closer to the position of Supreme Chancellor (Teem being a competitor for the Chancellorship). Jabba was subsequently able to warn Plagueis ahead of time of an attempt on his life by Gardulla, the Bando Gora, and Black Sun organized by Plagueis' one-time associate [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Plagueis was able to escape the conspirators' [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]] of Sojourn undetected and was rescued by Jabba's yacht [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']]. Perhaps coincidentally, Jabba had also played a small part in the acquisition of the [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear device]] used against Plagueis: Darth Sidious had sent his own apprentice, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], to the [[Cog Hive Seven]] prison to retrieve the weapon from the arms dealer [[Iram Radique]], with the eventual aim of delivering it to the Bando Gora so it could be used to [[Rule of Two/Legends|kill]] his master. When Jabba had attacked the prison with the ''Star Jewel'', Maul was able to escape (with the aid of Komari Vosa) aboard Jabba's ship, whereupon he passed the weapon on to Vosa. Whether this is how Jabba learned of Vosa's identity and of the attempt on Plagueis' life is unclear.''[[Maul: Lockdown]]'' In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], at the height of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo crisis]], Jabba and his rival met prior to the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of that year. Gardulla had made a full model of the racecourse, surprising Jabba. She also owned a machine that would tell her and Jabba the winner. To Jabba's surprise, it said the winner would be [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]], whereas Jabba's droid, [[R5-X2/Legends|R5-X2]], showed [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] would come in first, Gasgano in second, and [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]] in third; the droid also favored the enslaved Human Anakin Skywalker. [[File:JabbaPromo.png|thumb|left|200px|Jabba enjoying a [[Gorg/Legends|snack]] at the races.]] When the race began, Jabba hosted Gardulla as his guest as he presided over the race. Entering his box at the Mos Espa Grand Arena to wild cheers, Jabba signaled the start of the race by spitting a [[Gorg/Legends|gorg]] into the starting gong. When the race concluded, Jabba had to be awoken by Bib Fortuna after falling asleep during the race; though as Anakin Skywalker had come in first, Jabba had outsmarted Gardulla and won the bet.{{Film|I}} During the battle that occurred in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], Gardulla conceived a plot to assemble all her criminal underlings to launch an assault on the Tusken Raiders, dispatching the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to destroy their Jedi leader, [[Sharad Hett]]. Contemporaneously, Jabba had the idea of sending out his thugs to raid the Tusken camps, inciting the Sand People to launch their own raids. Jabba then planned to profit from this by selling [[Dreddon]]'s overpriced surplus weapons to defensive [[Moisture farmer/Legends|civilians]]. Gardulla's plot failed, forcing her to retreat to her palace in Mos Espa. This would be one of the Hutt's last confrontations with Gardulla. When the rivalry got out of hand, Jabba hired [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]—who had won an audience with the Hutt for bringing in the bounty for [[Longo Two-Guns]]—to finish her off once and for all. Jabba led Jango Fett to Gardulla, and was quite pleased to hear that Gardulla was "eaten" by her [[Gardulla's krayt dragon|pet]] [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]],''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' surprised though he was that Jango Fett never came to receive his bounty for Gardulla's death. He discovered the answer soon enough, for he later found out that Jango Fett was killed on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]. Later on, Jabba would do business with Jango Fett's clone son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]]. ====The Clone Wars==== {{Quote|A delicate situation is currently unfurling with our new allies, the Hutts. It is a predicament brought to our attention by no less than Jabba the Hutt, mighty leader of the Hutt clans.''"
"''"Mighty." It burns me that you should afford him any respect, your excellency.''"
"''In times of war, my lad, allegiances can often be strange indeed.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]''}} Following the [[Recapture of Sarapin|recapture]] of [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jabba found himself in a position he'd never imagined: aiding a top [[General/Legends|general]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Second Battle of Tatooine]]. Since [[Boorka]] the Hutt (a rival of Jabba's) was in league with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Jabba concluded that his fellow gangster had gone too far with his antics. Thus, when the Republic's newly arrived [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] army proved too small to attack the Confederacy's base on the planet, Jabba became involved.''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]'' [[File:Jabba_TCWPB.png|thumb|300px|Jabba during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].]] After bolstering their forces, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]] and [[Naat Reath]] successfully engaged the Separatist enemy and slew Boorka. For their troubles, Jabba gave them five thousand [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]]; glad to be rid of the rival. But Jabba, being a true crime boss, always tried to make profits by doing business with both sides of a war. When [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] member [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the wealthy [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], contacted him, Jabba agreed to help the Separatist smuggle huge shipments of construction materials and [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] to the planet [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] to aid in the construction of the newly-created [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|C-B3 cortosis battle droid]]. His involvement with the Confederacy was discovered by Republic informant [[Raala Ponchar]], but battle droids under the command of the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Saato]] captured her and she was imprisoned in his palace. When the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] learned of Ponchar's disappearance, they sent Anakin Skywalker to investigate. Jabba, however, quickly learned of Anakin's presence on Tatooine and his intentions after he was tipped off by Aurra Sing, and posted a bounty on Anakin's head. Despite having to contend with scores of bounty hunters, the young Jedi managed to free Ponchar from the palace's dungeon; he then killed Saato and relayed the information about Jabba's involvement to Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].''[[Star Wars: The New Droid Army]]'' Some time afterward, Boba Fett, the cloned "son" of Jango Fett, read his father's "book" which instructed him to visit Jabba. Fett had a run-in with the dangerous Separatist Commander [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], however, before he could do so. Fett soon managed to escape Durge, and quickly found himself in Jabba's employ. One of the reasons Jabba accepted Boba was to repay the favor Jango Fett did him by killing Gardulla the Hutt a decade earlier. While working for Jabba, Boba had separate plans that had nothing and everything to do with the Hutt at the same time. Besides this, Fett still had connections with the Separatists and [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku. [[File:Jabba_22BBY.png|thumb|left|250px|Jabba is told [[Rotta/Legends|his son]] has been kidnapped.]] As the war progressed, Jabba requested the Jedi's help in finding his son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], in exchange for passage through Hutt space, for the Separatists controlled all the major hyperspace lanes. He had dispatched a group bounty hunters who tracked his son to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], but they all were returned beheaded. Count Dooku and the CIS kidnapped Jabba's son, allowed the Jedi to get him back, and employed lies, a secret video, and an all-out assault to get him back and to curry the crime lord's favor. Ultimately, the Jedi proved victorious and eventually earned Jabba's trust for a time, thus allowing [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|his Empire]] to ally with the Republic against the CIS during the war. Jabba was angry at the main instigator of the plot, his own uncle [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], who was planning to take control of his nephew's empire.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] Some time later, Jabba was later approached by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]], the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], who held in a standoff against one of Jabba's bounty hunters, [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]]. He appealed to Jabba as a fellow parent to ask for assistance in tracking down his daughters [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]] and [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]]. He reasoned that if Greedo's blood matched the sample that he found on Coruscant, then it will prove that the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was involved in the kidnapping. No sooner did Jabba did permit a blood sample to be taken, did Greedo spill that he was working for the Separatists. He then led the Pantorans to Mos Eisley, where one of the girls was located. During another time, Jabba hired bounty hunter Cad Bane to get information about the Senate building. After Bane's success, Jabba talked to the Hutt Council to see if Ziro should be released from prison. The Hutts hired Bane and he succeeded. Then, Jabba hired Sy Snootles to steal information from Ziro. Sy betrayed Ziro and killed the Hutt, and gave Jabba the diary of the Hutts. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Darth Maul, his brother [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] went to the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] in [[Hutt Council Chamber/Legends|their chambers]] on Nal Hutta to ask for an alliance with the Hutts, promising to spare their lives in exchange for the Hutt territories and everything in it's borders. Jabba and the other elders just laughed and sent bounty hunters after them. While [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]] and Jabba were seen on holograms, the others, except for [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], escaped from the [[Mission to Nal Hutta/Legends|skirmish]]. Maul and [[Shadow Collective/Legends|company]] soon arrived at Jabba's Palace on Tatooine, where they launched an [[Attack on Jabba's Palace/Legends|attack]] on the Monastery. Maul and the others found Jabba, with Gorga, in his throne room, where they forced the mighty crime lord to join the Collective. ===Underling mayhem (22 BBY–3 ABY)=== ====Majordomo==== {{Quote|You and me, Bib. You and me|Jabba|''[[Jabba the Hutt: Betrayal]]''}} [[File:Jth_tgsh.jpg|thumb|160px|Jabba with [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]].]] Jabba had several lieutenants, and over time, each one helped him control a certain part of the growing criminal empire of Jabba's. His oldest, and best, majordomo was [[Naroon Cuthus]], whom Jabba respected but couldn't let retire, since he knew too much about Jabba's activities. So, in return for his long service, Jabba gave him a quick death. The ensuing power vacuum created a rivalry between Bib Fortuna and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Bidlo Kwerve/Legends|Bidlo Kwerve]] for the seat as Jabba's right hand man. Jabba enjoyed watching the competition and pitted the two cronies against one other. When Jabba was given his "beloved" pet [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]], Kwerve got the pleasure of being the monster's first public feast, with Fortuna becoming Jabba's new majordomo by default. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jabba's father, Zorba, was imprisoned after being tried for illegal gemstone mining, convicted, and sentenced to prison on [[Kip]]. After a bribery attempt to free Zorba failed, [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|Jiliac]] assumed control of the Desilijic clan, with Jabba next in the line of succession. Jabba also regularly employed many bounty hunters, one of his favorites being a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] named [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]]. Jabba hired the bounty hunter for many successful yet infamous missions. Jabba eventually suggested that Zuckuss team up with a modified [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] named [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]], who had been given a programming upgrade by Jabba's workers. Jabba was pleased with the pair's work and frequently employed them. ====Dealing with scum==== {{Quote|I can see that you're eager to get down to business, and so am I.|[[Suppoon]]|''[[Jabba the Hutt: The Gaar Suppoon Hit]]''}} [[File:Deal_art2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jabba and Suppoon have a "friendly" dealing.]] At an unknown point between the [[Declaration of a New Order]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and the Battle of Yavin, Jabba ended up getting a bounty on his head by the Galactic Empire.''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], rival crime lord [[Sise Fromm]] had his son, [[Tig Fromm]], design a super weapon in the form of a weapons satellite, [[Trigon One]]. The satellite had the power to level planets and the [[Fromm Gang]] hoped to use it to force other cartels into submission, including Jabba's. The plan was exposed when the Trigon One was destroyed by speeder racer [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] with assistance from his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. In response, the Bloated One put a bounty on the Fromm Gang, hoping to completely destroy them while they were still reeling from their losses, due to their heavy investments in the Trigon. Bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] found the Fromms easily, as Sise Fromm contracted him to capture Joben and his friends for revenge. Fett initially honored the contract, due to a favor that the elder Fromm had done him in the past. However, in the ensuing pursuit, Fett lost [[Silver Speeder|his speeder]], [[BL-17|his droid]], and nearly his life, angering him to the point that he decided that his debt had been paid and he turned the Fromms over to Jabba. Sise survived the ordeal only by agreeing to a deal heavily slanted in Jabba's favor, promising the Hutt a large percentage of the Fromm family business profits and committing their army of [[Annoo-dat Blue|Annoo-dat]] clones to Jabba's attempt at removing the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] diaspora that had encroached on the his territory{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}} Around [[5 BBY/Legends|five years before]] the Battle of Yavin, Jabba took his [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']], and set off for the headquarters of [[Suppoon|Gaar Suppoon]], an old acquaintance of the Hutt's. Jabba informed Gaar that there was a bomb in his palace, but when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent [[Kosh Kurp]] to investigate, no bomb was discovered. After a heated trade war, with Jabba outwitting Gaar on every trade, Gaar tried to kill the Hutt. Jabba responded by letting loose a fatally poisonous [[Tromonid]] on Gaar, which bit him almost immediately. Threatening to blow everyone up with a bomb he possessed, Jabba persuaded Gaar to give him everything they traded for an antidote to the fatal bite. When Gaar was reminded about the bomb, he played along and asked Jabba to detonate it. Things took a turn for the worst when Jabba called Gaar by his real name, [[Suppoon|Sonopo Bomoor]]. Kurp, recognizing the name as that of the man who had killed his family, took a shot at the man. The [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt ricocheted, exploding Gaar's head. Kurp realized he was the actual "bomb", and had played right into Jabba's plan. While leaving the planet, [[Scuppa]], the captain of Jabba's ship, spotted a [[Nuffin]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], which they believed to have a wealth of riches ripe for the taking. Jabba, Bib Fortuna, and two [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]] boarded the ship, leaving a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guard behind to guard the [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']]. When the group entered the vessel, they were taken captive by the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Nampi]]. Nampi put the guards and Bib into the larder, while Jabba and Scuppa confronted her. Jabba was eventually sent to the larder as well, refusing to give up the riches in the ship. Scuppa, being an opportunist, realized that he was now in charge of Jabba's finances and agreed to marry Nampi to preserve his life. The act was foolish, and he didn't realize in his haste that Nampi's species ate the male on the wedding night. In horror, Scuppa realized that he'd become Nampi's appetizer. When Jabba was called into her chambers to be the main course, the Hutt quickly deduced what had happened, and used the situation to his advantage. Long beforehand, Jabba had installed a remote in Scuppa's skull that released [[Xenoboric acid/Legends|Xenoboric acid]] should his captain ever betray him. Now in control, he offered Nampi a chance to give over her riches, lest he detonate the remote. Upon her refusal, he pushed it, without a hint of regret, and, in a matter of seconds, Nampi exploded. The guards and Bib were soon unlocked, and started to loot Nampi's hold. Humorously, Jabba suggested that his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] majordomo "wear his boots" into the exploded viscera. Jabba planned to sell Nampi's ship to [[Cabrool Nuum]] when they were finished with it. When faced with what to do with the deceased Princess's guards, however, Bib at first suggested selling them to Nuum as enslaved people, but Jabba had a more sadistic idea. He decided to launch them into the vacuum of space to "see 'em pop." At first, when Jabba met up with Nuum, the meeting between the two crime lords was friendly. Things began to turn sour, however, because of an argument with Nuum about the offer of Jabba murdering [[Vu Chusker]], Nuum's rival. Nuum sent Jabba to a spare room, where, afterward, Nuum's son, [[Rusk Nuum|Rusk]], soon contracted Jabba to kill his father instead. Jabba proudly obliged. With Nuum suffocated in his sleep, Jabba enlisted Rusk as a dealer and partner. Rusk objected, and sent Jabba to the deep holds. While in the prison, Jabba met another member of Nuum's family, [[Norba Nuum|Norba]], Rusk's sister, who wanted Rusk dead. Jabba agreed, and crushed Rusk in the creature's office with his own two hands, helped in part by Norba. Norba then proceeded to send the Hutt to the deep hold. [[File:Norba_death.jpg|thumb|200px|Jabba "eliminating" [[Norba Nuum]].]] When Norba came to visit the Hutt, Jabba laughed when she said she wanted Vu Chusker dead. Jabba leaned towards the bars of the cell, telling her to listen up. When she leaned in to listen, he pulled her into his mouth and ate her. He then grabbed the keys and escaped. During his escape, Jabba ran into—of all beings—Vu Chusker. Without warning, Jabba crushed Chusker into the ground and hovered to his ship via [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsor sled]]. The Hutt thought, in hindsight, thought he should have just killed Chusker in the first place. [[File:Jabba_attack.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Attack of the freckers.]] At the time Jabba returned to his palace, his devious majordomo, Bib Fortuna, had recruited six of Jabba's more dissatisfied minions (including [[Nivek (criminal)|Nivek]]) to kill Jabba's guards after making them tell all of their secrets to him. Unfortunately, shortly after they started putting the plan into action, guards [[Gru'um Ropple|Gru'um]] and [[Miramba]] unleashed a pack of [[frecker]]s, thus spoiling the plan. Bib and the would-be assassins managed to kill all the freckers, earning thanks from the Hutt for remaining a loyal hero. Fortuna couldn't bring himself to kill Jabba following this. After all, Nivek and the other co-conspirators died in the struggle with the freckers, taking Bib's failed plan with them to the grave. ====Intrigue among the Hutts==== Soon, the talents of a young, roguish [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] caught the eye of Jabba and his great-uncle, Jiliac. Impressed with the boy's performance, the pair hired Han to smuggle [[Spice/Legends|spice]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], thus profiting from the distribution of the illegal drug. Han quickly proved his mettle, and was given tougher and more exciting assignments such as the infamous [[Kessel Run/Legends|Kessel Run]]. Initially unbeknownst to Han, Jiliac and Jabba were preparing to make their bid for supremacy among the Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] by targeting the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] clan's spice refining operation on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. Han's piloting abilities while flying for the Desilijic clan allowed him to narrowly escape a brutal pirate attack, the blame of which was this laid upon the Besadiis. [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk the Hutt]], clan leader of Besadii, and his offspring, [[Durga Besadii Tai|Durga]], were outraged at the ensuing claims. A Council was convened on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to discuss the recent events, the resulting verdict finding the Besadii clan innocent of all transgressions. It was then that Jabba and Jiliac decided that Aruk needed to die. Contacting the High Priest [[Teroenza]] of [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]], Jabba and Jiliac arranged for a [[Malkite Poisoners|Malkite]] poison to be used to kill Aruk. Although Aruk was successfully slain, Imperial entanglements threatened to ruin life for the Hutts when [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Sarn Shild]] announced a campaign against Nal Hutta and Nar Shaddaa. The savvy Hutt families tried to bribe Shild, but when that failed, Jabba and Jiliac instructed Han Solo to contact the Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] leading the attack and subvert him. Solo was successful in buying the Imperial battle plan, and began preparations to defend Nar Shaddaa. As a backup, the Hutts hired [[Drea Renthal]]'s mercenary fleet to protect Nal Hutta. Surprisingly, the smugglers and spacers of Nar Shaddaa, with the aid of Drea Renthal and the Imperial battle plan, [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|defeated]] the Imperial forces, allowing the Hutts to escape the wrath of the Empire. It wasn't long before Aruk's son, Durga, suspected Jiliac's involvement in his father's demise and challenged Jiliac's right to rule under [[Old Law]]. In the impending duel, Durga slew Jiliac. Whereas most beings would have felt grief or anger, Jabba only saw an opportunity to advance. By killing Jiliac's helpless orphaned youngling, Jabba successfully established himself as the leader of the Desilijic kajidic. ====Smuggler scandal==== {{Quote|Han, my boy, you disappoint me.|Jabba|translated=1|{{Film|IV}}}} [[File:Jabbathehutt94.png|thumb|200px|Jabba chiding Han Solo in [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] looks on.]] A [[Rybet/Legends|Rybet]] named [[Moruth Doole]] was Jabba's main source of spice. Doole's knack for picking competent smugglers made transport much easier. Having encountered Han Solo and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] many times on their spice runs, Doole had no objections about turning in the smuggler to the authorities, if it paid the right amount. The ensuing Imperial patrol came crashing down on one of Jabba's spice runs that Solo was hauling. Unknown to many, Doole was the reason for Solo's loss of Jabba's paid-in-advance spice cargo. Originally, Jabba held Han solely accountable; however, Jabba eventually found out that Doole was spice skimming, and, suspecting Doole's betrayal, posted a contract on him. Doole staged a prison revolt on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] in order to draw attention away from himself. Although the warden worked for Jabba, more than half the guards of the prison were secretly being paid by Doole, making the ploy that much easier. However, Doole was captured, and was soon brought before the Hutt. In an act of mercy, he begged to be left alive: Doole traded one of his eyes for his life. The price of the lost cargo was once more attributed to Solo. Seven years after Jabba's demise, Moruth Doole would meet his end at the fangs of a hungry [[energy spider]]. ====Underworld overlord==== {{Quote|Jabba, you're a wonderful human being.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|}} By the dawn of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], Jabba had become the most powerful crime lord in the Outer Rim, perhaps even the galaxy. This was largely due to his near monopoly of the [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] business. By this time, the Desilijic kajidic had become the largest and most powerful among all the Hutt dynasties, trumping even their sworn enemies, the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] Hutts; Jabba using every opportunity to destroy the rival clan's conglomerate. [[File:Jabba-NEGTC.png|thumb|left|200px|Jabba the Hutt]] Even at the height of his reign, the crime lord dealt with recurring problems: chronic illness caused him constant discomfort, and even his closest lieutenants had begun plotting his demise. The Hutt put his trust in no one other than his [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] accountant [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]] and [[Ephant Mon/Legends|Ephant Mon]], whom he made Chief of Security of his palace. It was at this time that the Hutt suffered a major financial loss when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], his best [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], dropped an entire cargo of valuable glitterstim while on a dangerous mission near [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. The spice was dropped because Han was boarded by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] customs team. Jabba demanded that Han pay him the value of the cargo, but when the smuggler failed to reimburse his long-time employer, the Hutt put a bounty on Han's head. [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] attempted to collect the bounty, but was killed by Han. Following the death of Greedo, Jabba confronted Han in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]{{'s}} [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|hangar bay]], where he agreed to let Han go in exchange for a premium of fifteen percent. He left Han with a warning that if he delayed payment again, he would put a price on his head so high that Han would not "be able to go near a civilized system." Han then sarcastically acknowledged Jabba as being a "wonderful human being."{{Film|IV}} After the Battle of Yavin, it was speculated that Jabba was the underworld kingpin who funded the Imperial [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark trooper]] project and provided the Empire with smuggling ships. His thugs hunted [[Kyle Katarn]], since [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rom Mohc]] put a bounty on his head. Katarn, along with [[Jan Ors]], however, managed to complete their [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Dark Trooper campaign)|mission]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by vanquishing all the thugs that hunted him. However, Jabba's ship captured the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'', Katarn's ship, as they left the moon. Katarn and Jan Ors were imprisoned in the ''Star Jewel'' and were to be fed to [[Kell dragon/Legends|kell dragons]], but Katarn was able to escape Jabba's clutches. This setback, however, was not a major concern for the criminal overlord. Days after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Solo paid Jabba 500,000 credits worth in ancient Sith treasure, through [[Sprool]] the Trader. Jabba accepted the gift, but kept the bounty on Han, for it was too little, too late. However, Jabba soon forgave Solo's debt after the smuggler saved his accountant [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]] (under the alias Jabba the ''Hut'') from the stone-mites on planet Orleon. After that Han even made another Kessel Run for Jabba."[[The Second Kessel Run]]" But this quiet period for Solo was short-lived, because when Mosep found [[Crimson Jack/Legends|Crimson Jack's]] wrecked ship—which Jabba helped to refit and recondition—and learned about Han's part in destroying it, the bounty was once again placed on his head. In the years following the Battle of Yavin, Jabba the Hutt went into a strong rivalry with [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]] and her [[Valarian Syndicate|criminal organization]], also based on Tatooine. At some point, Lady Valarian tried to have Jabba assassinated by a team of elite off-world specialists. However, the Hutt crime lord discovered the plot and Jabba's henchmen killed Lady Valarian's team during an assault on the [[Valarian Strategic Command Bunker]].{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Jabba The Hutt|Tatooine}} ====Jabba and the Zann Consortium==== Some time before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jabba entered into a partnership with the weapons dealer [[Tyber Zann]]. However, neither partner apparently planned on this alliance being permanent. When Tyber learned that Jabba had purchased an artifact that had cost him half his great wealth the young smuggler struck. Tyber took several squads of mercenaries to [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], where Jabba met the Imperials to whom he was selling the artifact. Tyber managed to steal the artifact, but was captured. Transmitting to Zann on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], he told him that he'd be dead, because he had sent an assassin to kill him. However, Tyber's associate, [[Urai Fen]], managed to free him, and Tyber would go on to form the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]], and decided to get his revenge on Jabba. He would go on to steal the Holocron. One battle of note between Jabba and the Consortium was the [[Ground Battle on Hypori|Battle of Hypori]]. Using a listening post on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] Jabba had pinpointed the Constortium's bases and sent saboteurs to hit them. Although he was initially successful, Tyber rebounded and tracked down Jabba's droid factory on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]], to which he sent an attack force. Jabba suffered a rare defeat when [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] switched sides for triple pay and Tyber and Urai were able to slice the [[Droideka Mark II]]'s programming. With his newfound power Tyber killed Jabba's men and forced the Hutt to agree to a ceasefire that gave Tyber control of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]] and the bounty on his head called off. ===Chaos on Tatooine (3 ABY–4 ABY)=== ====Black Sun==== {{Quote|Oh, you'll find working for Jabba the Hutt REAL interesting!|[[Gizman|Big Gizz]] engaging [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]] about his job request|[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|''Shadows of the Empire'' comic]]}} [[File:GrossestBusinessLunchEver-SOTETC.jpg|thumb|250px|The new blood of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] criminal underworld.]] At the time of Jabba's campaign against the Jedi Order during the Purge, Jabba and Xizor built powerful criminal empires parallel to and in symbiosis with Palpatine's New Order. In the wake of the Clone Wars, c. [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], the galaxy's seats of power were still realigning. The Fromm family had begun to invest heavily in a covert project to build a powerful weapons satellite, dubbed ''[[Trigon One]]''. Using its orbital laser, Fromm made ambitious power grabs in his home system of [[Annoo system/Legends|Annoo]]. However, when both the ''Trigon'' and his palace were destroyed, Fromm's plans were foiled. Soon after, Jabba made a political move that established him as the galaxy's leading gangster. The quick-witted Hutt struck while the iron was hot and placed a bounty on the heads of the entire Fromm organization, aiming to crush them while they were still reeling from their losses. Because of a series of run-ins with Boba Fett, the elderly [[Annoo-dat]] gangster was captured and executed along with his son and chief officer of security. ====Solo, paid in full==== {{Quote|You may take Captain Solo to Jabba the Hutt after I have Skywalker.''"

"''He will not be permanently damaged.|Darth Vader and Boba Fett|{{Film|V}}}} [[File:Jabbagizz.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jabba instructs [[Gizman|Big Gizz]] on his next assignment.]]After the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Anakin Skywalker, now the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, sent an agent named [[Wrenga Jixton|Jix]] to spy on Jabba, and to keep an eye out for his son [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]], making sure nothing happened to the boy. While on Tatooine, he ran into [[Gizman|Big Gizz]] and his swoop gang. They brought him before Jabba, since he was "looking for a job". When Jabba received word that Luke was more valuable dead than alive, Jix was confused; he thought Vader wanted the boy alive. With that in mind, when the gang ambushed Luke, Jix stopped Gizz from fatally shooting the young Jedi by knocking the swooper out cold with a rock. Luke took out the rest of the gang, while [[Spiker]], another swooper, rode off with Jix. Jabba was furious and yet curious about the situation at the same time. He believed that it had been a great amount of luck for one man. Jabba then explained that a change of plans has happened: Lord Vader wanted his son dead, though unbeknownst to the Hutt, it was really Xizor who was after Luke. He had his suspicions about Jix, since he knew the other bikers were too stupid to betray him. In the meantime, Boba Fett was trying to get the bounty for Solo by bringing the smuggler to the Hutt. When one of Jabba's aides found Jix messing with the security codes for a transmission, Jix killed the aide and took the key to the security code and transmitted to Vader. Right before Fett arrived, Jabba wondered why one of his aides was murdered. Right after he accused Jix, Fett arrived. He offered five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to anybody who could bring him Solo (so that he would not have to pay Fett the outrageous price). However, Fett did manage to come through and collect the bounty that Jabba was so hesitant to pay. Bossk and Fett would continue to stay in Jabba's court for the remainder of the time Solo was his captive. Zuckuss left, since he had business elsewhere, while the others stuck around at Jabba's palace. At the same time, the Hutt grew increasingly hedonistic, spending millions on a [[Jabba's demolition games|vehicular demolition event]] with few survivors and even fewer rules after he received the frozen Solo. Most of the contestants who entered saw the tournament as a lucrative opportunity for glory and riches, including Boba Fett, the Dug podracer [[Pugwis]], and the Jawa warlord [[Wittin/Legends|Wittin]]. Others were desperate for credits, such as the Wookiee mechanic [[Quagga]] and the deserting Imperial General [[Otto]]. Others had personal vendettas, such as famed Bounty Hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. Other contestants included those in Jabba's employ looking to increase their prestige with the Hutt, such as Tamtel Skreej (actually Lando Calrissian in disguise), and the Rancor keeper [[Malakili]]. Some, however, were forced into the tournament agains their will, such as the twin Rebel pilots [[Tia (pilot)|Tia]] and [[Ghia]], along with Alderaanian smuggler [[Wade Vox]]. The tournament was a huge success, and Jabba made an incredibly large amount of credits from the venture.''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]'' However, Jabba's victory was soon disrupted by two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and a message. ====The infiltration==== {{Quote|I am taking Captain Solo and his friends. You can either profit by this or be destroyed. It's your choice, but I warn you not to underestimate my powers.|Luke Skywalker to Jabba the Hutt|}} The Hutt was greatly pleased with Han's delivery, turning the carbon-frozen captive into his "[[Man in Carbonite|favorite decoration]]," having him hung on a wall in his audience chamber. First, Luke Skywalker sent [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to Jabba with a message, and as a gift. Escorted past Jabba's Gamorrean guards, the droids delivered Luke's message, asking to bargain for Solo. Jabba, bemused, rejected the offer and put his new droids to work.{{Film|VI}} [[File:JabbaChewie.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jabba negotiates Chewbacca's bounty.]] Afterward, the Hutt listened to the [[Max Rebo Band/Legends|Max Rebo Band]] sing "[[Jedi Rocks/Legends|Jedi Rocks]]," as the enslaved Twi'lek [[Oola/Legends|Oola]] danced. Demanding a repeat, Jabba tried to bring Oola to him, but she resisted and Jabba pressed his trapdoor button and let his [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] eat her. Directly after the death of Oola, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], brought [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] as her "prisoner". Jabba and the ersatz Boushh bargained over the price on the Wookiee's head, eventually agreeing on 35,000 credits after the bounty hunter pulled a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] out and threatened to activate it. Chewbacca was imprisoned in Jabba's dungeons, while Boushh remained in the Palace, waiting for evening. In the ensuing ruckus caused by the disguised Princess' arrival, several of Jabba's captives from the demolition games managed to escape, including the Alderaanian smuggler Wade Vox, and the Rebel twins Tia and Ghia. [[File:JabbasNewSlave-RotJAVA.png|left|thumb|Jabba licked Leia after discovering her identity]] Later that night, Leia thawed Han Solo out of the block of [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] he was in. However, Jabba had suspected treachery and immediately captured them. Han tried to bargain with the gangster, saying that he was sidetracked, but Jabba said it was too late and imprisoned Solo in the same cell as Chewbacca. Meanwhile, having decided to replace Oola by enslaving Leia, Jabba ordered his guards to bring her to him. The crime lord dismissed Leia's threats and proceeded to lick her face, much to her disgust.[[Return of the Jedi (radio)|''Return of the Jedi'' radio drama]] Jabba then ordered the Max Rebo Band to play music while his dancers dressed her in a [[Huttese slave-girl costume]], which included a [[Shock collar/Legends|collar]] that chained Leia to the Hutt's [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|throne]].{{StoryCite|story=And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} In the immediate aftermath of Han and Leia's capture, several of the palace court members were putting plans in motion to end Jabba's life. [[J'Quille/Legends|J'Quille]], who was working as a spy for Lady Valarian, came into possession of Leia's thermal detonator,{{StoryCite|story=Let Us Prey: The Whiphid's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} only to have it stolen by Fortuna.{{StoryCite|story=Of the Day's Annoyances: Bib Fortuna's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} [[Tessek/Legends|Tessek]] had a bomb planted on the sail barge.{{StoryCite|story=A Free Quarren in the Palace: Tessek's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} Though [[Ree-Yees/Legends|Ree-Yees]] also had plans to kill Jabba, he was unaware the the Hutt had a short-range bomb implanted in him, which would explode if Jabba uttered a certain phrase.{{StoryCite|story=Goatgrass: The Tale of Ree-Yees|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} Jabba sent Leia to Boba Fett's quarters one night as a gift. Even though he wasn't interested in her, Fett decided not to send her back to Jabba until the next morning, because he knew doing otherwise would insult Jabba and likely result in Leia being fed to the rancor. Also unbeknownst to Jabba, his chef [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] was cooking meals for Han in order to help cure his [[Hibernation sickness/Legends|hibernation sickness]]. However, Jabba had started to become suspicious that the chef was putting [[fierfek]], a hex, in his food. Leia tried to clear Porcellus's name by eating a sample of the [[sandmaggot]] [[Kidney/Legends|kidneys]] he prepared for the Hutt, only to become nauseated as the food was indigestible to humans, causing Jabba to laugh in amusement.{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} [[File:Luke_the_hutt.png|thumb|left|250px|Luke meets with Jabba while an enslaved Leia sits before the Hutt.]] After a few days,{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}} Luke Skywalker finally arrived at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Jabba and most of his minions were asleep, but were awoken by Bib Fortuna, who was [[Mind trick/Legends|mind tricked]] by the Jedi. Luke demanded the return of Solo and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], warning that Jabba would be destroyed if he didn't comply. When Jabba refused to bargain, Luke [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force pull|Force pulled]] a gun from a neighboring guard named [[Nizuc Bek/Legends|Nizuc Bek]]. Jabba caused the young Jedi and a nearby Gamorrean named [[Jubnuk/Legends|Jubnuk]] to drop down a trap door, into the lair of [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|Jabba's rancor]]. The rancor ate Jubnuk first as Jabba laughed in amusement, then went for Luke. After bashing its claw with a rock and ramming a bone into its mouth, Luke ran between the monster's legs to the other side of the monster's lair. There, he managed to kill the ferocious beast by destroying the control panel for the door thus dropping a gate on the monster; the sharp points at the bottom of the door piercing the beast's skull and killed it. Infuriated by the death of his rancor, Jabba took out his anger by choking Leia and demanded the other Rebels be brought to him. [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was present at Jabba's Palace on [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] orders, disguised as the dancing girl Arica, planning to kill Luke, whom she would later marry and become a member of the [[New Jedi Order]]. [[Melina Carniss]], a member of Jabba's secret security detail, suspected her of being out to assassinate the Hutt and attempted to have her imprisoned, despite failing this she had made it impossible for Mara to complete her mission.{{StoryCite|story=Sleight of Hand: The Tale of Mara Jade|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}} ====Showdown at the Pit of Carkoon==== {{Quote|Threepio, you tell that slimy piece of worm-ridden filth he'll get no such pleasure from us! Right?''"
"''Jabba, this is your last chance. Free us or die.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|}} An enraged Jabba, translated through Threepio, stated that Solo, Chewbacca, and Luke were to be taken to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]], to be fed to the fearsome [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]].
